text: The monitor flashes black every few seconds, and the power cable feels loose.
I am locked out of the email app after the password change and need to send a contract today.
The guest Wi-Fi is slow in the lobby this afternoon.
The label printer is making a grinding sound and won't print shipping labels; orders are piling up.
The spreadsheet app shows an error when I try to open the budget file. It can wait until tomorrow.
Nobody in the branch can access the internet, and customers are waiting. This is a disaster.
Can I get a second monitor for my desk sometime this month?
The calendar application keeps freezing when I accept meeting invitations.
My phone cannot connect to the company Wi-Fi since I changed my network password.
I am so upset: the laptop won't turn on and I have a board meeting in ten minutes.
